input.quote: This Agreement will automatically renew for additional 1-year terms unless earlier terminated pursuant to this Agreement's express provisions (together with the Initial Term, such additional periods the "Term"). Neither Party may terminate this Agreement during the Initial Term except as set forth in paragraph 4(b) or any Exhibit. Either Party may terminate this Agreement for any reason following the Initial Term upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other Party.
input.rationale: The Agreement auto-renews for successive 1-year terms (acceptable length), but the only exit after the Initial Term requires ninety (90) days' written notice, which sits at the walk-away boundary and well outside the preferred 30-day (fallback 60-day) window; there is also no express non-renewal right and no Vendor reminder before renewal. Redline shortens the notice to 30 days, adds an express non-renewal election, and requires Kubient to give a 60-day renewal reminder. No renewal price-uplift cap is proposed because compensation is a revenue share set in each Exhibit rather than a fixed fee subject to uplift.

ops.oldText: Either Party may terminate this Agreement for any reason following the Initial Term upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other Party.
ops.newText: Either Party may terminate this Agreement for any reason following the Initial Term upon thirty (30) days written notice to the other Party, and either Party may elect not to renew this Agreement by giving written notice to the other Party at least thirty (30) days prior to the end of the then-current term. Kubient shall notify Customer in writing at least sixty (60) days prior to the end of the then-current term of the upcoming automatic renewal.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have shortened the notice required to exit or decline renewal after the Initial Term from ninety (90) to thirty (30) days and added a Kubient reminder sixty (60) days before each renewal, consistent with our position that auto-renewals must be easy to exit. If helpful, we can accept sixty (60) days' notice as a fallback.
proposal.summary: Shorten post-Initial Term exit/non-renewal notice from 90 to 30 days and add a 60-day Kubient renewal reminder.
